title: Patient Financial Assistance Program: Credit on the Response Days for Documents Already on File
content:
**Rule.** On a documents request under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, a file credit is taken off the response days by the documents already received for the case: a case with at least 6 documents received takes off the most-documents credit of 3 days; a case with at least 3 but fewer than 6 documents received takes off the some-documents credit of 1 day; any other case takes off nothing.

Each document received for the case counts once, as the case records its receipt; a document of one type received on one date is one document.

| Documents received for the case | Credit taken off the response days |
|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | None |
| 3, 4 or 5 | 1 day |
| 6 or more | 3 days |

**Boundaries.** At 2 documents no credit applies and at 3 documents the 1-day credit applies; at 5 documents the 1-day credit applies and at 6 the 3-day credit applies.
